q: Quantas lojas tem cada marca?
sql: SELECT b.name, count(*) FROM stores s JOIN brands b ON b.id = s.brand_id GROUP BY b.name

q: Qual a faturação total de 2025?
sql: SELECT round(sum(total), 2) FROM sales WHERE sold_at >= '2025-01-01' AND sold_at < '2026-01-01'

q: How many employees does each store have?
sql: SELECT s.name, count(*) FROM employees e JOIN stores s ON s.id = e.store_id GROUP BY s.name

q: Qual o método de pagamento mais usado?
sql: SELECT payment_method FROM sales GROUP BY payment_method ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

q: Qual a loja com mais vendas em outubro de 2026?
sql: SELECT s.name FROM sales v JOIN stores s ON s.id = v.store_id WHERE v.sold_at >= '2026-10-01' AND v.sold_at < '2026-11-01' GROUP BY s.name ORDER BY sum(v.total) DESC LIMIT 1

q: What is the average ticket at Café Aroma?
sql: SELECT round(avg(v.total), 2) FROM sales v JOIN stores s ON s.id = v.store_id JOIN brands b ON b.id = s.brand_id WHERE b.name = 'Café Aroma'

q: Qual o produto com maior margem percentual?
sql: SELECT name FROM product_margins ORDER BY margin_pct DESC LIMIT 1

q: Quantas compras estão por receber?
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM purchases WHERE status = 'encomendada'

q: Quantas transferências houve em 2026?
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM transfers WHERE transfer_date >= '2026-01-01' AND transfer_date < '2027-01-01'

q: Which ingredient is the most expensive per unit?
sql: SELECT name FROM ingredients ORDER BY unit_cost DESC LIMIT 1

q: Qual foi a faturação de cada marca em outubro de 2026?
sql: SELECT b.name, round(sum(v.total), 2) FROM sales v JOIN stores s ON s.id = v.store_id JOIN brands b ON b.id = s.brand_id WHERE v.sold_at >= '2026-10-01' AND v.sold_at < '2026-11-01' GROUP BY b.name

q: How many hours were worked in shifts at BurgerLab Maia in October 2026?
sql: SELECT round(sum(extract(epoch FROM sh.end_time - sh.start_time)) / 3600, 1) FROM shifts sh JOIN employees e ON e.id = sh.employee_id JOIN stores s ON s.id = e.store_id WHERE s.name = 'BurgerLab Maia' AND sh.shift_date >= '2026-10-01' AND sh.shift_date < '2026-11-01'

q: Que percentagem dos talões de 2026 foi paga com MB Way?
sql: SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE payment_method = 'mbway') / count(*), 1) FROM sales WHERE sold_at >= '2026-01-01' AND sold_at < '2027-01-01'

q: Qual a diferença de faturação do grupo entre outubro e setembro de 2026 (outubro menos setembro)?
sql: SELECT round(sum(total) FILTER (WHERE sold_at >= '2026-10-01' AND sold_at < '2026-11-01') - sum(total) FILTER (WHERE sold_at >= '2026-09-01' AND sold_at < '2026-10-01'), 2) FROM sales WHERE sold_at >= '2026-09-01' AND sold_at < '2026-11-01'

q: Which menu sold the most units in 2026?
sql: SELECT m.name FROM sale_lines sl JOIN sales v ON v.id = sl.sale_id JOIN menus m ON m.id = sl.menu_id WHERE v.sold_at >= '2026-01-01' AND v.sold_at < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY m.name ORDER BY sum(sl.quantity) DESC LIMIT 1

q: Quantos pastéis de nata foram vendidos em outubro de 2026, contando também os vendidos dentro de menus?
sql: SELECT sum(q) FROM (SELECT sl.quantity AS q FROM sale_lines sl JOIN sales v ON v.id = sl.sale_id JOIN products p ON p.id = sl.product_id WHERE p.name = 'Pastel de nata' AND v.sold_at >= '2026-10-01' AND v.sold_at < '2026-11-01' UNION ALL SELECT sl.quantity * mi.quantity FROM sale_lines sl JOIN sales v ON v.id = sl.sale_id JOIN menu_items mi ON mi.menu_id = sl.menu_id JOIN products p ON p.id = mi.product_id WHERE p.name = 'Pastel de nata' AND v.sold_at >= '2026-10-01' AND v.sold_at < '2026-11-01') t

q: What is the total stock of Leite across all stores (excluding warehouses)?
sql: SELECT round(sum(st.quantity), 2) FROM stock st JOIN ingredients i ON i.id = st.ingredient_id WHERE i.name = 'Leite' AND st.store_id IS NOT NULL

q: Quanto Café em grão há em stock em cada armazém?
sql: SELECT w.name, round(sum(st.quantity), 2) FROM stock st JOIN warehouses w ON w.id = st.warehouse_id JOIN ingredients i ON i.id = st.ingredient_id WHERE i.name = 'Café em grão' GROUP BY w.name

q: How many warehouse transfers did the stores of each brand receive in 2026?
sql: SELECT b.name, count(*) FROM transfers t JOIN stores s ON s.id = t.store_id JOIN brands b ON b.id = s.brand_id WHERE t.transfer_date >= '2026-01-01' AND t.transfer_date < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY b.name

q: Qual o valor total das compras recebidas com data de encomenda em 2026?
sql: SELECT round(sum(pl.quantity * pl.unit_cost), 2) FROM purchases p JOIN purchase_lines pl ON pl.purchase_id = p.id WHERE p.status = 'recebida' AND p.ordered_at >= '2026-01-01' AND p.ordered_at < '2027-01-01'

q: Qual o talão médio por método de pagamento em 2025?
sql: SELECT payment_method, round(avg(total), 2) FROM sales WHERE sold_at >= '2025-01-01' AND sold_at < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY payment_method

q: How many store employees does each brand have?
sql: SELECT b.name, count(*) FROM employees e JOIN stores s ON s.id = e.store_id JOIN brands b ON b.id = s.brand_id GROUP BY b.name

q: Qual o custo horário médio dos baristas?
sql: SELECT round(avg(hourly_rate), 2) FROM employees WHERE role = 'barista'

q: What was the monthly revenue of BurgerLab Maia in the first quarter of 2026 (January to March)?
sql: SELECT round(sum(v.total), 2) FROM sales v JOIN stores s ON s.id = v.store_id WHERE s.name = 'BurgerLab Maia' AND v.sold_at >= '2026-01-01' AND v.sold_at < '2026-04-01' GROUP BY date_trunc('month', v.sold_at)

q: Em que hora do dia a Café Aroma Porto teve mais talões em 2026?
sql: SELECT extract(hour FROM v.sold_at) FROM sales v JOIN stores s ON s.id = v.store_id WHERE s.name = 'Café Aroma Porto' AND v.sold_at >= '2026-01-01' AND v.sold_at < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

q: Qual foi o crescimento percentual da faturação do grupo de setembro para outubro de 2026?
sql: WITH m AS (SELECT sum(total) FILTER (WHERE sold_at >= '2026-09-01' AND sold_at < '2026-10-01') AS sep, sum(total) FILTER (WHERE sold_at >= '2026-10-01' AND sold_at < '2026-11-01') AS oct FROM sales WHERE sold_at >= '2026-09-01' AND sold_at < '2026-11-01') SELECT round(100 * (oct - sep) / sep, 1) FROM m

q: What share (%) of the group's 2026 revenue did each brand have?
sql: SELECT b.name, round(100 * sum(v.total) / sum(sum(v.total)) OVER (), 1) FROM sales v JOIN stores s ON s.id = v.store_id JOIN brands b ON b.id = s.brand_id WHERE v.sold_at >= '2026-01-01' AND v.sold_at < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY b.name

q: Quais são as 2 lojas com mais faturação em 2026 dentro de cada marca?
sql: WITH r AS (SELECT s.brand_id, s.name, rank() OVER (PARTITION BY s.brand_id ORDER BY sum(v.total) DESC) AS rk FROM sales v JOIN stores s ON s.id = v.store_id WHERE v.sold_at >= '2026-01-01' AND v.sold_at < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY s.brand_id, s.name) SELECT name FROM r WHERE rk <= 2

q: Qual a margem total gerada pelas vendas de outubro de 2026, contando produtos e menus?
sql: SELECT round(sum(sl.quantity * (sl.unit_price - coalesce(pm.unit_cost, mm.unit_cost))), 2) FROM sale_lines sl JOIN sales v ON v.id = sl.sale_id LEFT JOIN product_margins pm ON pm.product_id = sl.product_id LEFT JOIN menu_margins mm ON mm.menu_id = sl.menu_id WHERE v.sold_at >= '2026-10-01' AND v.sold_at < '2026-11-01'

q: Which brand generated the highest total margin in 2026, counting both products and menus?
sql: SELECT b.name FROM sale_lines sl JOIN sales v ON v.id = sl.sale_id JOIN stores s ON s.id = v.store_id JOIN brands b ON b.id = s.brand_id LEFT JOIN product_margins pm ON pm.product_id = sl.product_id LEFT JOIN menu_margins mm ON mm.menu_id = sl.menu_id WHERE v.sold_at >= '2026-01-01' AND v.sold_at < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY b.name ORDER BY sum(sl.quantity * (sl.unit_price - coalesce(pm.unit_cost, mm.unit_cost))) DESC LIMIT 1

q: Quantos produtos estão classificados como 'cão' nas recomendações de preço, por marca?
sql: SELECT b.name, count(*) FROM price_recommendations pr JOIN brands b ON b.id = pr.brand_id WHERE pr.classification = 'cão' GROUP BY b.name

q: Which products are classified as 'estrela' in the price recommendations?
sql: SELECT name FROM price_recommendations WHERE classification = 'estrela'

q: Comparando janeiro a outubro de 2025 com janeiro a outubro de 2026, qual a loja com maior crescimento percentual de faturação?
sql: WITH f AS (SELECT s.name, sum(v.total) FILTER (WHERE v.sold_at >= '2025-01-01' AND v.sold_at < '2025-11-01') AS y25, sum(v.total) FILTER (WHERE v.sold_at >= '2026-01-01' AND v.sold_at < '2026-11-01') AS y26 FROM sales v JOIN stores s ON s.id = v.store_id GROUP BY s.name) SELECT name FROM f ORDER BY (y26 - y25) / y25 DESC LIMIT 1

q: What was the total staff cost (shift hours × hourly rate) per brand in October 2026?
sql: SELECT b.name, round(sum(extract(epoch FROM sh.end_time - sh.start_time) / 3600 * e.hourly_rate), 2) FROM shifts sh JOIN employees e ON e.id = sh.employee_id JOIN stores s ON s.id = e.store_id JOIN brands b ON b.id = s.brand_id WHERE sh.shift_date >= '2026-10-01' AND sh.shift_date < '2026-11-01' GROUP BY b.name

q: Em cada marca, qual o produto mais vendido em unidades em 2026, contando só as vendas avulsas (sem menus)?
sql: WITH u AS (SELECT p.brand_id, p.name, rank() OVER (PARTITION BY p.brand_id ORDER BY sum(sl.quantity) DESC) AS rk FROM sale_lines sl JOIN sales v ON v.id = sl.sale_id JOIN products p ON p.id = sl.product_id WHERE v.sold_at >= '2026-01-01' AND v.sold_at < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY p.brand_id, p.name) SELECT name FROM u WHERE rk = 1
